subtasks.title: count words that appear exactly once
subtasks.goal: Add a function to src/count.rs that returns how many whitespace-separated words appear exactly once in the text, comparing words case-insensitively and ignoring surrounding punctuation the same way unique_words does. Add unit tests in the existing tests module: an empty text has zero, 'a b a' has one, 'a b c' has three, and 'The the' has zero because both spellings are the same word.

dod.statement: the new counting rule is implemented and covered by unit tests that pin both the positive and the duplicate case

subtasks.title: print the unique count and add the flag
subtasks.goal: In src/main.rs print a line 'unique: N' after the existing three lines, using the function added by the previous subtask. Also accept a --unique flag as the first argument that, when present, prints only that number and nothing else. Keep the usage message and the existing behaviour of printing all four lines unchanged.

dod.statement: the binary prints the unique count, the flag prints only it, and the project still builds and tests green
